description: Pixaro helps authorized business users review order analytics, search individual orders and POS transactions, check CCTV availability for transactions, inspect payout summaries, and examine payout breakdowns with linked orders. It provides read-only operational and financial reporting for stores the user is permitted to access.

defaultPrompt: Show my order performance for the last 30 days, including trends, peak hours, and top-selling items.
Summarize this month’s payouts, then show the linked orders for the most recent payout.
Find recent void transactions that have CCTV video available.
